items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mike was playing up there a while ago, Mike Abene. [INTERVIEWEE] Right. They have ads on their front windows about all the jazz and artists they have.

ctx.x: of Broadway, about the middle of the block. It's between 113th and 114th, on the west side of Broadway and it's in the center of the block, and I think it's called the West End Restaurant; something like that. It's right in the middle of the block. (West End Cafe)
Mike was playing up there a while ago, Mike Abene.
Right. They have ads on their front windows about all the jazz and artists they have.
